mission: 'A part-time, remote research fellowship that enables aspiring AI safety and policy researchers to work on impactful research projects with professionals in the field.' Mentees commit 5–40 hours/week for three months ending in a Demo Day; Fall 2026 had 250+ mentors. SPAR says its research has been accepted at ICML and NeurIPS. Founding year approximate; expansion of the acronym is the commonly used one, not stated on the homepage.

key_work.title: PersistBench: When Should Long-Term Memories Be Forgotten by LLMs?
key_work.plain_summary: SPAR mentee paper (ICML 2026) on when AI assistants should forget stored memories.

warnings.text: Risks from advanced AI need more researchers than full-time programmes can train (programme rationale).

recommendations.text: Offer flexible, part-time mentored research so people can contribute alongside other commitments.
